rich_text.plain_text: piece went deep on the painters. This shelf hands the North to the photographers. It is the same light the painters chased, the long low sun, the white winters, the stillness, only now it arrives through a lens and a darkroom rather than a brush. Set one of these on the table beside a print on the wall and you are looking at two halves of the same country, a century or so apart and chasing the same weather. Five books, one from each Nordic nation.
